app.name: MuxMultiTool
app.tagline: A self-hostable ffmpeg GUI for lossless cutting, remuxing and stream selection.

help.title: Help
help.body: Keyboard shortcuts and a short guide per screen appear here once the editors exist. Until then, every screen explains which feature it is waiting for.

about.title: About MuxMultiTool
about.body: Version, repository, license and the bundled ffmpeg build are listed here by the About screen (TASK-48).

codes.internal: The backend hit an internal error

filePicker.title: Choose files
filePicker.placeholder: The folder browser over the files service arrives with the Files screen (TASK-18). Nothing can be chosen yet.

files.description: Browse the media folders, select files by wildcard and read the per-stream report.

streams.description: Pick the streams to keep, apply filter rules by language, codec or id, and preview the ffmpeg command.

combine.description: Copy streams between files and build one output from several sources.

cut.description: Player, timeline with thumbnails and waveform, segments, keyframe, normal and smart cut.

merge.description: Join files with identical codecs after a compatibility check.

images.description: GIF, snapshots, cover art and lossless crop.

batch.description: Apply an operation to every matching file in a folder, with a filename template and a preview.

presets.description: Saved operations, reusable from every screen.

jobs.description: Progress, ETA, speed, cancel, and readable errors with the raw ffmpeg output.

settings.description: Appearance, shortcuts, paths and the ffmpeg capability check.
